amendments.body: Add a test asserting that REFERENCE_SA_V_CM2_PER_L matches the actual default TankState geometry. Currently the constant 1000.0/19.0 is documented to match the default 40x25 cm footprint with 3 cm substrate (~19 L net), but nothing enforces this at compile-time or test-time. If the default substrate depth, geometry dimensions, or displacement model change, compute_o2_kla silently produces incorrect normalization (ratio != 1.0) for the default tank. A single test like `assert!((state.geometry.surface_area_cm2() / state.water_volume_l() - REFERENCE_SA_V_CM2_PER_L).abs() < 0.01)` on a default TankState would catch this.
amendments.rationale: The SA/V normalization is the core physics change in this bead. Its correctness for the default tank hinges on a hardcoded constant matching a separately-defined default geometry. A silent mismatch would change gas exchange rates for every default-geometry simulation without any test failure or warning.

amendments.body: The TUI api_client normalize_snapshot_object function adds canonical fields from legacy aliases but does not strip the legacy or API-injected metadata fields (chemistry_field_semantics, estimated_tds_scope, legacy_chemistry_aliases) before calling serde_json::from_value. This works only because TankSnapshot omits #[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]. Add a test to api_client that deserializes a full snapshot_response_json() output (which includes all metadata fields) through parse_snapshot_value, verifying the TUI client can handle the enriched API response end-to-end — not just hand-crafted legacy-only payloads.
amendments.rationale: The existing api_client tests only cover legacy-to-canonical normalization with hand-built JSON. No test exercises the actual wire format the API server produces (snapshot_response_json), which includes 3 extra metadata objects and 8 legacy alias fields. If a future change adds deny_unknown_fields to TankSnapshot or the API adds more metadata, there is no test to catch the breakage in the TUI client.

payload.summary:
Thorough review of the tanksim-6e5.2.7 bead covering: (1) dissolved_oxygen.rs SA/V normalization for O2 K_LA, (2) CO2 exchange test updates for new area-proportional flux physics, (3) API snapshot handler refactoring with chemistry field semantics, TDS scope documentation, and legacy alias support, (4) TUI chemistry/overview screen labeling updates with TDS scope annotations, (5) water.rs GH constant extraction from magic numbers, (6) TUI api_client backward-compatible snapshot normalization, (7) habitat registry refresh tests, (8) save/load registry rebuild test, (9) startup override enum variant updates.

All core physics, conversion math, and backward-compatibility logic is correct. The SA/V normalization is physically sound and consistent between O2 and CO2 (CO2 delegates to O2 K_LA). Conversion constants in conversions.rs match the bead's reference values with round-trip tests. TDS/conductivity are properly labeled as estimates with tracked/omitted ion documentation in both TUI and API. Legacy field aliasing handles both old-server→new-client and new-server→old-client scenarios correctly. All tests pass. Two amendments proposed: (1) a guard test linking the SA/V reference constant to the actual default geometry, and (2) an end-to-end test ensuring the TUI client can deserialize the full enriched API snapshot response format.
